# Archie McNicol

Archie McNicol is a UK content creator, community manager, photographer and digital creative.

## Public profile
- Creator handle: @fitswitharchie
- Focus: fashion and lifestyle short-form content, creator communities, photography, performance partnerships and digital projects
- Creator audience: 25K+ social community
- Creator content: 20M+ views across content
- Community experience: 3+ years supporting creator communities and operations for CapCut, with UK creators as the primary market and cross-border communication with an internal team in Shanghai, China
- Photography: journey began around 2018 and developed into travel, aerial, event and lifestyle work
- Photography archive: 616 public photographs
- Education: completed A-levels in Geography, Media Studies and Photography in 2026 before moving directly into full-time creative work
- Location: United Kingdom
